title: Data Specialist (with Advanced English)
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


About the Role:

We’re currently working on expanding our Central Data Team to increase our product portfolio with members who build, create and maintain our data products. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply.

The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.

See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!


As Our Data Specialist, you will:

  • Take ownership of high-impact work with guidance — whether that’s running or building data products end-to-end, supporting centralized data ingestion pipelines the broader team relies on, or building clean, granular data feeds that help clients dive into data.
  • Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and datasets we analyze. You’ll learn our proprietary methods and techniques, building the judgment and mental models to understand why our data works — not just how to produce it.
  • Use AI and tooling to accelerate your learning and work — assisting with queries, investigations, debugging, and repetitive tasks. You’ll develop the habit of validating AI-generated outputs rather than assuming correctness, building a foundation for using AI effectively throughout your career here.
  • Become a trusted resource for internal stakeholders and clients , working with them to identify and answer key questions. You’ll contribute to data feeds, custom analyses, and reports consumed by the top investors in the world.
  • Improve the products, pipelines, and data feeds you own — we value curiosity and experimentation, and we expect you to follow established best practices while also questioning the status quo and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Learn or sharpen SQL, Python, and PySpark skills starting with our two-month new hire training program covering technical fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have a strong ownership mentality — you want to ensure our products are the best in the world and take personal responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks
  • You have strong attention to detail and produce work with minimal errors
  • You communicate clearly, both orally and in writing — including proactively sharing progress, blockers, and updates
  • You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible and are excited about using AI and tooling to work smarter
  • You can manage multiple priorities and stay organized
  • You are experimental and curious — energized by learning and not afraid to change the status quo
  • You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company


What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

  • We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, team events and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.



We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.




Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Solution Architect
description:
🚀 We're Hiring: Sr. Solution Architect

We’re looking for an experienced Solution Architect with 15+ years of experience and a strong hands-on engineering background who can bridge business needs and technology and turn complex requirements into practical, scalable solutions.


LOCATION: Remote


This is a delivery-focused architecture role — not a pure governance position. You’ll work closely with Business, Product, and Engineering teams, helping shape solutions from requirements and architecture through implementation and production.


What we're looking for:

  • 15+ years of overall technology experience , with strong Solution Architecture and hands-on engineering experience.
  • Azure cloud experience.
  • Strong .NET / C# background preferred , although candidates with comparable enterprise stacks such as Java may be considered.
  • Broad exposure to modern application, cloud, integration, and data technologies.
  • Ability to evaluate technologies and clearly to explain architectural trade-offs.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.


Technology environment:

Azure | .NET | C# | Angular | Python | React | Databricks | Cloud Automation | Cloud-native apps

Nice to have: Next.js | JavaScript | TypeScript


If you're a hands-on architect with 15+ years of experience who enjoys solving complex problems and working across Business, Product, and Engineering, we'd love to hear from you!

title: SAP IBP Consultant
description:
SAP IBP Demand Planning Consultant

Program: Global SAP S/4HANA Rollout (80+ countries)

Location: Anywhere in LATAM - Full Remote

Contract: Freelance, initially 6 months + extensions


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced SAP IBP Demand Planning Consultant to support a multi-year global S/4HANA rollout. You will design, configure, and deploy SAP IBP for Demand, balancing global process standardization with regional requirements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Configure SAP IBP for Demand, including forecasting, demand sensing, planning areas, key figures, master data, and time profiles
  • Define forecast models and aggregation/disaggregation logic
  • Lead fit-gap workshops and requirements gathering with global and regional stakeholders
  • Support integration with S/4HANA and other demand-signal systems
  • Manage testing, data migration, cutover, go-live, and hypercare activities
  • Provide training, documentation, and knowledge transfer
  • Monitor forecast accuracy, bias, and related KPIs
  • Collaborate with Supply, Inventory, and S&OP workstreams


Required Experience

  • 5+ years in SAP IBP Demand Planning
  • At least two full-cycle IBP for Demand implementation
  • Hands-on experience with planning areas, key figures, master data, forecasting models, and time-series algorithms
  • Strong knowledge of statistical forecasting, demand sensing, consensus planning, MAPE, and bias
  • Experience integrating IBP with S/4HANA using CPI-DS, Integrated Data Services, or SAP Cloud Integration
  • Experience in global, multi-country rollout programs
  • Strong stakeholder management and English communication skills

title: Interpreter
description:
WE ARE HIRING POLISH INTERPRETERS!!!


LANGUAGE : Polish and English Interpreter

As a remote interpreter, you play a significant role in facilitating communication between Polish and English speakers. The interpreter needs to be able to process information quickly and with accuracy in a professional manner. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment. Note pads and writing utensils, glossaries, and dictionaries are useful tools.


Candidate Qualifications:

  • Fluency in English and Polish
  • Minimum 1 year interpretation experience preferred but not required.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Ability to explain certain cultural concepts to avoid miscommunication with permission or at the request of the client.


Technical Requirements:

  • Computer or Laptop
  • Windows 10 or higher
  • USB Wired headset
  • Steady wired internet connection


Additional information:

  • Remote position, interpreter works from his/her home office
  • Ongoing training and competency opportunities
  • Monthly payments
  • Per minute rate


**Based on your location, language testing and background check may be required**

title: Vendedor de Sorvetes (Diversas Regiões do Brasil)
description:
A vida fica melhor com sorvete

Com 19.000 especialistas em sorvetes e marcas icônicas como Kibon, Cornetto e Ben & Jerry’s, amadas em 76 países, somos a maior empresa de sorvetes do mundo e líder do setor. Levamos o prazer a sério há mais de 100 anos, proporcionando felicidade a cada lambida ou bola de sorvete e criando momentos especiais para gerações.


A The Magnum Ice Cream Company é movida pelo crescimento: crescemos nosso negócio, impulsionamos o crescimento dos negócios dos nossos clientes e desenvolvemos a carreira das nossas pessoas. O crescimento começa com o empoderamento. Por isso, damos aos nossos colaboradores a liberdade para agir como empreendedores inovadores e responsáveis, motivados e preparados para oferecer aos nossos consumidores produtos excepcionais e momentos inesquecíveis — e se divertir ao longo dessa jornada.


Sobre a Função

Seu propósito será impulsionar a presença, o abastecimento e a visibilidade de Kibon no ponto de venda, executando o roteiro definido e assegurando os padrões de execução, para gerar crescimento sustentável da carteira e experiência de compra diferenciada.


Responsabilidades

  • Vendedor de Sorvetes é responsável por execução operacional e presença de Kibon nos PDVs da rota, com média de 20 visitas/dia, garantindo abastecimento, visibilidade, layout e precificação, excelência em Loja Brilhante, registro no Sistema de Vendas e estímulo ao pedido via Digital.
  • Roteiro & Produtividade: visitar em média 20 clientes por dia com disciplina e pontualidade, garantindo cobertura integral da carteira e continuidade dos atendimentos;
  • Execução de Loja: assegurar abastecimento, layout, precificação e materiais de visibilidade conforme guia de execução; realizar limpeza e conservação dos equipamentos; remover produtos estranho / danificados e / ou produtos que não sejam Kibon e que estejam presentes nos equipamentos.
  • Carteira: atua sob orientação e com responsabilidade direta pelos resultados da carteira.
  • Loja Brilhante: realizar a pesquisa de Loja Brilhante com evidências (fotos) e registrar a execução no aplicativo corporativo.
  • Sistemas & Dados: abrir/fechar visitas, registrar pedidos, ocorrências e evidências no sistema de vendas; utilizar os insights de vendas para priorização e melhoria de execução.
  • Pontos Quentes: negociar o melhor posicionamento dos equipamentos (pontos quentes) para maximizar visibilidade e giro.
  • Omnicanalidade do Pedido: orientar e influenciar o cliente a comprar via digital, quando aplicável, aumentando frequência e recorrência de pedidos.
  • Suporte Técnico: abrir e acompanhar chamados técnicos quando necessário em caso de quebra de equipamento, registrando aprovações/laudos conforme processo vigente.
  • Ativação & Desativação: negociar recolha/desativação de equipamentos, conforme diretrizes comerciais.
  • Prospecção: prospectar novos clientes na área de atuação, visando preenchimento e expansão de cobertura da rota.


Qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Desejável superior (incompleto) em andamento.
  • Vivência com vendas e execução de rotina comercial.
  • Facilidade com tecnologia (celular, apps de pedido, sistemas de vendas, excel básico, entre outros).
  • CNH B ativa e disponibilidade para deslocamentos diários na rota.


Por que se juntar a nós?

Aqui está o que define o sucesso em nossa organização:


  • Somos totalmente focados em crescimento.
  • Atuamos com velocidade e simplicidade.
  • Vencemos juntos, com diversão.
  • Somos corajosos para inovar e transformar nossa indústria.
  • Nós nos importamos com as pessoas e nos desafiamos constantemente.
  • Somos especialistas no negócio de sorvetes.

Este é um lugar para pessoas apaixonadas por sorvete e que buscam crescimento — tanto para o negócio quanto para si mesmas. Pessoas que agem como donas do negócio e conduzem tudo de ponta a ponta. Pessoas motivadas pelo sucesso, que entregam mais do que jamais imaginamos ser possível!


Você se encaixará aqui se valorizar uma cultura inclusiva e estiver entusiasmado(a) em aprender continuamente e desafiar a forma como trabalhamos, utilizando recursos digitais, dados e novas ideias para nos impulsionar cada vez mais.


Oferecemos

  • Cargos com verdadeira responsabilidade e impacto visível.
  • Liberdade para agir com rapidez, experimentar e desafiar a forma como as coisas são feitas.
  • Aprendizado e desenvolvimento contínuos, à medida que o negócio cresce.
  • Reconhecimento e recompensa alinhados ao desempenho e à contribuição de cada pessoa.


VOCÊ ESTÁ PRONTO(A) PARA CONSTRUIR O FUTURO DOS SORVETES?

Inscreva-se online e não se esqueça de enviar seu currículo. Sua candidatura será analisada de acordo com os requisitos da vaga, e entraremos em contato após o encerramento do processo para informar o status da sua inscrição.


Se você é uma pessoa com deficiência e precisar de apoio em qualquer etapa do nosso processo de recrutamento, entre em contato com o seu Talent Acquisition Partner.


Empregador que promove a igualdade de oportunidades


A The Magnum Ice Cream Company é uma empresa comprometida com a igualdade de oportunidades. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para contratação independentemente de raça, cor, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, origem nacional ou qualquer outra condição protegida pela legislação aplicável. Não toleramos qualquer forma de discriminação, inclusive com base em deficiência.

title: Vendedor de Sorvetes (Diversas Regiões do Brasil)
description:
A vida fica melhor com sorvete

Com 19.000 especialistas em sorvetes e marcas icônicas como Kibon, Cornetto e Ben & Jerry’s, amadas em 76 países, somos a maior empresa de sorvetes do mundo e líder do setor. Levamos o prazer a sério há mais de 100 anos, proporcionando felicidade a cada lambida ou bola de sorvete e criando momentos especiais para gerações.


A The Magnum Ice Cream Company é movida pelo crescimento: crescemos nosso negócio, impulsionamos o crescimento dos negócios dos nossos clientes e desenvolvemos a carreira das nossas pessoas. O crescimento começa com o empoderamento. Por isso, damos aos nossos colaboradores a liberdade para agir como empreendedores inovadores e responsáveis, motivados e preparados para oferecer aos nossos consumidores produtos excepcionais e momentos inesquecíveis — e se divertir ao longo dessa jornada.


Sobre a Função

Seu propósito será impulsionar a presença, o abastecimento e a visibilidade de Kibon no ponto de venda, executando o roteiro definido e assegurando os padrões de execução, para gerar crescimento sustentável da carteira e experiência de compra diferenciada.


Responsabilidades

  • Vendedor de Sorvetes é responsável por execução operacional e presença de Kibon nos PDVs da rota, com média de 20 visitas/dia, garantindo abastecimento, visibilidade, layout e precificação, excelência em Loja Brilhante, registro no Sistema de Vendas e estímulo ao pedido via Digital.
  • Roteiro & Produtividade: visitar em média 20 clientes por dia com disciplina e pontualidade, garantindo cobertura integral da carteira e continuidade dos atendimentos;
  • Execução de Loja: assegurar abastecimento, layout, precificação e materiais de visibilidade conforme guia de execução; realizar limpeza e conservação dos equipamentos; remover produtos estranho / danificados e / ou produtos que não sejam Kibon e que estejam presentes nos equipamentos.
  • Carteira: atua sob orientação e com responsabilidade direta pelos resultados da carteira.
  • Loja Brilhante: realizar a pesquisa de Loja Brilhante com evidências (fotos) e registrar a execução no aplicativo corporativo.
  • Sistemas & Dados: abrir/fechar visitas, registrar pedidos, ocorrências e evidências no sistema de vendas; utilizar os insights de vendas para priorização e melhoria de execução.
  • Pontos Quentes: negociar o melhor posicionamento dos equipamentos (pontos quentes) para maximizar visibilidade e giro.
  • Omnicanalidade do Pedido: orientar e influenciar o cliente a comprar via digital, quando aplicável, aumentando frequência e recorrência de pedidos.
  • Suporte Técnico: abrir e acompanhar chamados técnicos quando necessário em caso de quebra de equipamento, registrando aprovações/laudos conforme processo vigente.
  • Ativação & Desativação: negociar recolha/desativação de equipamentos, conforme diretrizes comerciais.
  • Prospecção: prospectar novos clientes na área de atuação, visando preenchimento e expansão de cobertura da rota.


Qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Desejável superior (incompleto) em andamento.
  • Vivência com vendas e execução de rotina comercial.
  • Facilidade com tecnologia (celular, apps de pedido, sistemas de vendas, excel básico, entre outros).
  • CNH B ativa e disponibilidade para deslocamentos diários na rota.


Por que se juntar a nós?

Aqui está o que define o sucesso em nossa organização:


  • Somos totalmente focados em crescimento.
  • Atuamos com velocidade e simplicidade.
  • Vencemos juntos, com diversão.
  • Somos corajosos para inovar e transformar nossa indústria.
  • Nós nos importamos com as pessoas e nos desafiamos constantemente.
  • Somos especialistas no negócio de sorvetes.

Este é um lugar para pessoas apaixonadas por sorvete e que buscam crescimento — tanto para o negócio quanto para si mesmas. Pessoas que agem como donas do negócio e conduzem tudo de ponta a ponta. Pessoas motivadas pelo sucesso, que entregam mais do que jamais imaginamos ser possível!


Você se encaixará aqui se valorizar uma cultura inclusiva e estiver entusiasmado(a) em aprender continuamente e desafiar a forma como trabalhamos, utilizando recursos digitais, dados e novas ideias para nos impulsionar cada vez mais.


Oferecemos

  • Cargos com verdadeira responsabilidade e impacto visível.
  • Liberdade para agir com rapidez, experimentar e desafiar a forma como as coisas são feitas.
  • Aprendizado e desenvolvimento contínuos, à medida que o negócio cresce.
  • Reconhecimento e recompensa alinhados ao desempenho e à contribuição de cada pessoa.

title: Remote Commercial Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz


Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.


We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.


We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.


Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.


The Role


  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies — on both the buy side and the sell side.
  • Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes.
  • Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.


What You'll Bring


  • 5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house.
  • Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination.
  • Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective.
  • Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise.
  • Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.


Why Moritz


  • Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.


Frequently Asked Questions


How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?


Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.


What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?


Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.


Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?


No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.


How are co-counsel matched to client matters?


Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Corporate Travel Agent
description:
Job Description: Senior Corporate Account Manager


Company Overview:

bTd Travel & Jets is a leading global concierge travel company with a presence in the US, Brazil, and Portugal and expanding to Spain and Mexico in 2025 and across Europe, Latin America, and GCC later. bTd operates under three innovative models: B2C  (exclusive membership services), B2B  (corporate travel management), and B2B2C  (travel concierge services for business partners). Within the B2B model, we specialize in delivering cutting-edge corporate travel management solutions through our bTd Corp Tool .

This platform seamlessly blends intuitive technology with personalized services, simplifying business travel with exclusive rates on commercial flights, hotels, car services worldwide, with automated processes, and a focus on exceptional customer satisfaction. Beyond corporate travel, we also provide employees with access to bTd travel benefits  and personalized concierge services for their leisure trips, enriching their overall travel experiences.


CX Travel Specialist (2 positions: Either Early Morning Shift - From 4 AM to 13 PM Brazil time or From 4 PM to 1 AM Brazil time)

We are looking for two (2) CX Travel Specialist  to join our Customer Experience (CX) team. The ideal candidates are experienced with Amadeus and corporate travel management to support our global clients during night shifts.


Main Responsibilities

• Manage bookings for flights, hotels, and car rentals via Amadeus and other tools.

• Handle client requests, changes, and special services via WhatsApp and email.

• Process exchanges, refunds, EMDs, and monitor itineraries proactively.

• Support VIP and C-level travelers with high-touch, discreet service.

• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accuracy and client satisfaction.


Requirements

• Experience in luxury or corporate travel.

• Strong experience with Amadeus GDS (Air module) - Advanced level

(An Amadeus Test will be conducted to verify level of proficiency before any job offer is sent)

• Background in TMCs, agencies, or airlines.

• Proficiency in English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus.

• Tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and flexible for night/weekend shifts.

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills across multiple languages.
  • Intermediate knowledge in NDC platforms is required.
  • Effective training and delegation skills, with a \"learning by doing\" approach.
  • Ability to navigate diverse geographic markets and cultural contexts effectively.

• Knowledge of ARC (USA) and or IATA BSP accounting process is a plus


Why Join Us

• Work in a dynamic, global environment focused on service excellence.

• Engage with high-profile clients and premium travel partners.

• Be part of a collaborative, growth-oriented culture.

• Enjoy a remote-first setup with flexible work arrangements


bTd Travel Culture:

At bTd, we are passionate about travel, bridging distances, connecting worlds, and creating unique experiences for our clients. We foster a culture that embodies entrepreneurship, hands-on collaboration, and teamwork. Our flexible work environment supports work-life balance, eliminating commuting time and offering opportunities for relocation or nomadic work. We are driven by a global mindset, a passion for client success, and a strong focus on results. Our environment values risk-taking, leadership development, and learning by doing, providing multiple opportunities for personal and professional growth. We respect diversity at all levels and embrace meritocracy, rewarding high performance and ensuring no space for toxic behavior or poor performance.

bTd is committed to corporate governance, ethics, and mutual trust, building confidence through facts and evidence rather than perceptions. We promote an open, friendly, and respectful atmosphere where differences and preferences are honored. Join us and grow alongside bTd, with the opportunity to become part of the company’s evolution and stakes.


Terms of Employment:

  • Employment under CLT (Brazilian Labor Laws) .
  • Remote work arrangement, with a 44-hour workweek
  • Flexibility to travel domestically within Brazil and internationally to locations where bTd operates.
  • This position is required or night shift and weekends, with flexibility.
  • Excels in remote work for a global hybrid startup, combining tech-driven travel solutions with personalized services.


Compensation:

  • Competitive base salary.
  • Night shift extra hours
  • Performance-based bonuses and monthly premiums based on achieving KPIs.
  • Sales commissions for achieving and exceeding targets.
  • Health and dental insurance.
  • Food card.
  • Birthday day off.
  • Opportunity for professional growth, with the potential to be promoted to Head of Corporate Globally  as bTd evolves through its funding rounds.
  • Access to travel-related perks and benefits as part of the bTd team.


Important Note Before Applying:

Let’s keep it real! Apply only if you meet at least 80% of the qualifications  and can prove it with your LinkedIn profile or updated resume . We’re not looking for someone who just \"gets it\" — we need a self-starter  ready to deliver results from day one .

Forget gaming LinkedIn algorithms; we care about real achievements. If your experience matches the role and your profile shows your impact, we’re excited to hear from you, hire you fast, reward your contributions, and grow together.

Note:  Only candidates meeting the criteria will be contacted for an interview. Let’s keep it efficient and worthwhile for everyone! 🚀


bTd Travel – Where Business Meets Innovation.

title: Remote M&A Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz


Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.


We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.


We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.


Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.


The Role


  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M&A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents.
  • Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing.
  • Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W&I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.


What You'll Bring


  • 5+ years practising M&A or corporate law in private practice or in-house.
  • End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams.
  • Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics.
  • Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on.
  • Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.


Why Moritz


  • Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.


Frequently Asked Questions


How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?


Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.


What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?


Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.


Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?


No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.


How are co-counsel matched to client matters?


Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Account Manager
description:
We're Convert Sail, an e-commerce conversion optimization agency. We work with Shopify brands spending $100K-$1M+/month on ads, and we move fast. Really fast.


We're looking for an Account Manager to own client relationships and project delivery. You'll manage 8-10 client accounts, coordinate landing page and funnel builds with our design and dev team, and be the main point of contact when clients need something.


This isn't a 9-5 role where you clock out and forget about work. When a client has a launch on Saturday, you're online. When a project is behind, you stay late to fix it. We ship fast, we work weekends when it matters, and most people flame out in the first 90 days because they can't handle the pace.


If that scares you, this isn't the role for you.


If that excites you, keep reading.


What you'll do:


  • Own 8-10 client relationships and make sure they're happy, on track, and renewing long-term
  • Manage day-to-day client communication and set clear expectations
  • Coordinate landing page and funnel projects with our design and dev team—keep timelines tight and make sure nothing slips
  • Proactively identify and solve client issues before they become fires
  • Track project progress in ClickUp and ensure deadlines are met
  • Help clients see ROI from our work so they stick around for 6-12+ months, not 2-3
  • Be available during USA business hours and occasionally on weekends when client launches require it


What we're looking for:


  • 2+ years of experience managing client accounts in a fast-paced agency, SaaS company, or startup
  • Fluent English speaker with strong written and verbal communication skills
  • You've worked in high-pressure environments before and didn't crack under the weight
  • You're organized, proactive, and don't need someone checking in on you every 2 hours
  • You don't let things fall through the cracks—you follow up, you track details, you close loops
  • Experience with project management tools like ClickUp, Asana, or similar
  • Comfortable working remotely, but you don't treat \"remote\" like \"invisible\"
  • Bonus: Experience with e-commerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization (not required, but helpful)


What we offer:


  • Compensation: $12/hour ($2,000+/month full-time) + performance bonuses (depending on experience)
  • Fully remote—work from anywhere as long as you're available US hours
  • Work with real scaling brands, not broke startups or tire-kickers
  • Small team, so you'll have real impact and visibility
  • You'll learn more in 6 months here than 2 years at a slow-moving corporate job
  • Opportunity to grow into a senior role as the agency scales


How to apply:


Don't send a resume first.


Record a 4-minute Loom video (free tool, Google it if you don't know it) and tell us:


  • Why you want this job
  • Why we should hire you
  • A time you had to manage a difficult client situation and how you handled it


Then email the Loom link to:


Subject line must include the word BUILDER. If it doesn't, we'll assume you can't follow instructions and we won't read your application.


If you can't handle recording a 4-minute video, you definitely can't handle this role.

title: Remote Litigation Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz


Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.


We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.


We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.


Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.


The Role


  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's dispute resolution work in Brazil: commercial contract disputes, shareholder and post-M&A disputes, technology and IP disputes, debt recovery, and arbitration.
  • Lead case strategy, pleadings, evidence, and procedural steps for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies.
  • Advise clients on litigation risk before disputes arise — contract audits, escalation strategy, settlement positioning, and dispute resolution clauses.
  • Draft and negotiate letters before action, settlement agreements, and standstill and tolling arrangements; represent clients in mediation, arbitration, and court proceedings where licensed to do so.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.


What You'll Bring


  • 5+ years practising commercial litigation or arbitration in private practice or in-house.
  • Deep familiarity with contract disputes — breach, termination, damages, limitation of liability, and injunctive relief.
  • Advocacy and procedure. Confident managing proceedings end-to-end, with rights of audience or substantial arbitration experience (ICC, LCIA, or local institutions).
  • Strong drafting under pressure. Pleadings, witness statements, and settlement terms that hold up.
  • Commercial judgment. You know when to fight, when to settle, and how to explain the difference to a client.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.


Why Moritz


  • Bring modern tooling to dispute work — faster case preparation, sharper strategy, and clients who value clarity over billable churn.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.


Frequently Asked Questions


How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?


Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.


What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?


Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.


Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?


No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.


How are co-counsel matched to client matters?


Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Strategy & Operations Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role

At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You’ll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.


What you’ll be doing

  • Building and optimising scalable processes to continue Revolut's hyper-growth
  • Leading and executing core infrastructure projects
  • Exploring and defining which projects the team should prioritise, and setting a timeline to reach goals quickly
  • Searching for new features to provide a seamless customer experience
  • Managing critical vendor relationships and building performance tracking systems
  • Developing strategic supply chain partnerships and negotiating commercial terms


What you'll need

  • At least a 2:1 degree from a top university
  • 4+ years of work experience in a fast-paced environment
  • A solid track record of taking ownership and leading complex projects end to end
  • A magic skill to break complex problems into smaller ones
  • To enjoy working with data
  • Natural curiosity and a will to make an impact
  • An interest in the financial industry


Nice to have

  • Experience coding with SQL, Python, or R



Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Remote Real Estate Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz


Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.


We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.


We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.


Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.


The Role


  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's real estate work in Brazil: commercial leases, sale and purchase agreements, real estate aspects of corporate transactions, and development and construction agreements.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of leases and property transaction documents for clients ranging from startups taking their first office to enterprises managing property portfolios.
  • Run title review and property due diligence, including for real estate elements of M&A and financing transactions.
  • Advise on real estate financing and security, planning and zoning questions, and landlord-tenant matters.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.


What You'll Bring


  • 5+ years practising commercial real estate law in private practice or in-house.
  • Leasing depth. Office, retail, industrial, and flexible-space leases — rent review, service charges, repair obligations, break options, and assignments.
  • Transactional experience. Sale and purchase agreements, title review and due diligence, conditions, and completion mechanics.
  • Financing familiarity. Mortgages, security packages, and the real estate workstreams of corporate deals.
  • Practical judgment. You separate the points that protect the client from the points that stall the deal.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.


Why Moritz


  • Bring speed and clarity to real estate transactions traditionally slowed by process.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.


Frequently Asked Questions


How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?


Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.


What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?


Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.


Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?


No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.


How are co-counsel matched to client matters?


Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Senior DTC Video Editor
description:
We are a leading brand in health supplements for women over 40. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for women going through menopause by solving real, everyday challenges—weight gain, hot flashes, insomnia, mood shifts, and more.


We’re looking for a Senior DTC Video Editor to join our team full-time and help us create high-performing Meta video ads for our e-commerce brand.


What you’ll do:

  • Edit performance-driven DTC/Meta ads
  • Lead, train, and support a team of video editors
  • Review editors’ work and provide feedback
  • Help improve our editing processes and creative output
  • Have a calls with your team + video editing team


Requirements:

  • Strong experience editing DTC / Meta ads
  • Previous experience leading or training video editors
  • Strong understanding of direct-response creative
  • Excellent attention to detail and creative judgment
  • Full-time availability: 6 AM–2 PM EST
  • Experience with wellness or supplement brands is a big plus


IMPORTANT:

  • You must provide a portfolio showing Meta ads you personally edited.
  • Location: South America, Europe


Please also include:

  • Number of editors you’ve led/trained
  • DTC/e-commerce brands you’ve worked with
  • Your Meta ad editing experience Applications without relevant Meta ad examples will not be considered.


Resume must be in English.

title: Supervisor(a) de Relacionamento com o Cliente
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Supervisor(a) de Relacionamento com o Cliente , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Operações e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar, acompanhar e desenvolver o time de Relacionamento com o Cliente (Customer Service), promovendo engajamento e alta performance;
  • Acompanhar os principais indicadores da operação, como CSAT, TMPR e TMT, identificando desvios e conduzindo planos de ação;
  • Gerenciar a produtividade e a capacidade operacional, garantindo eficiência e fluidez no atendimento;
  • Monitorar o desempenho da IA de atendimento e dos fluxos da plataforma, identificando oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Realizar alinhamentos, 1:1 e feedbacks, apoiando o desenvolvimento das pessoas e a evolução do time;
  • Atuar na priorização de demandas e na resolução de problemas junto a outras áreas;
  • Conduzir processos seletivos e apoiar o onboarding e a integração de novas pessoas;
  • Analisar dados e apresentar os resultados da operação, consolidando indicadores e planos de ação para os acompanhamentos semanais e mensais.


Requisitos

  • Experiência em operações de atendimento ao cliente nos canais de chat e e-mail;
  • Experiência com liderança de equipes compostas majoritariamente por profissionais juniores e estagiários;
  • Experiência no acompanhamento de indicadores operacionais e gestão de performance;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e habilidade para utilizar dados na tomada de decisão;
  • Experiência com gestão de produtividade, capacidade operacional e rotinas de atendimento;
  • Vivência em gestão de pessoas, incluindo 1:1, feedbacks, desenvolvimento e acompanhamento de performance;
  • Experiência na contratação, integração e desenvolvimento de novos colaboradores;
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de atendimento e ferramentas de gestão operacional;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Google Sheets ou Excel para acompanhamento e análise de indicadores;
  • Experiência com dashboards e acompanhamento de KPIs;
  • Perfil orientado à melhoria contínua, resolução de problemas e eficiência operacional.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em startups, empresas de tecnologia, marketplaces ou empresas de logística;
  • Experiência com Customer Experience (CX) e indicadores de satisfação, como CSAT e NPS;
  • Experiência com operações que utilizam IA e automação no atendimento;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de Business Intelligence, como Looker Studio ou Power BI;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA Generativa aplicadas à produtividade, análise de dados e operações;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de atendimento e gestão de tickets, como HubSpot ou similares.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.


O que oferecemos:

  • 🧾Modelo de contratação: PJ;
  • Modelo de trabalho 100% remoto: uma oportunidade de crescimento acessível para talentos em todo o Brasil;
  • ⚕ Plano de Saúde: mantenha-se saudável com nosso abrangente plano de saúde nacional com consultas online e presenciais;
  • ♀️GymPass/Wellhub: bem-estar completo para você cuidar da sua saúde física e mental com os aplicativos integrados;
  • Voucher Kit Escritório: receba um voucher para turbinar o seu espaço de trabalho e garantir seu conforto, comodidade e produtividade;
  • Férias remuneradas: desfrute de 30 dias de férias remuneradas por ano para recarregar suas energias e relaxar;
  • Programa Super-Get-Super: indique um talento e receba um bônus;
  • 😊Cultura colaborativa: nossa cultura é baseada na confiança, parceria e foco em resultados. Oferecemos um ambiente com autonomia e transparência;
  • Incentivo ao desenvolvimento: estamos comprometidos com a excelência e o aprendizado contínuo. Oferecemos avaliações semestrais, conversas de one-on-one, feedbacks construtivos, e muito mais;
  • Programa de Stock Option: possibilidade de se tornar sócio da empresa e participar diretamente do nosso crescimento. Somos reconhecidos como uma das startups mais promissoras do Brasil pela lista 100 Startups to Watch.



E aí, vamos juntos nesse SuperFoguete? 🚀

title: FinCrime Analyst (Investigations) - Brazil
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people.


People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.



About the role

Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.


We’re looking for a Financial Crime Analyst to identify suspicious activity and ensure we’re treating customers fairly. You’ll be investigating internal SARs and complex cases by applying judgement, analytical skills, and solid decision-making to identify where grounds for suspicion of money laundering exist.


To support our 24/7 coverage, this role may include night and weekend shifts, which are fully compensated.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.



What you'll be doing

  • Reviewing, investigating, and reporting financial crime cases
  • Providing ongoing monitoring and resolving formal complaints and Financial Ombudsman Service complaints
  • Dealing appropriately with consent refusals following SAR submissions
  • Acting as a point of contact for law enforcement agencies in ongoing criminal investigations that commenced from a submitted SAR
  • Acting in accordance with written policies, procedures, and relevant legislation
  • Cooperating with other teams by providing professional and efficient front-line compliance support, seeking to improve company processes



What you'll need

  • A bachelor's degree (must be able to provide a certificate)
  • 3+ years in financial crime investigations, or 1+ years of SAR reporting experience
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (C1+ level)
  • Experience working in a regulated or policy-driven environment (e.g., financial institutions, law enforcement)
  • Experience with investigative methodologies, evidenced by the use of analytical tools (e.g., spreadsheets, filters, pivots, network charts)
  • The ability to work with multiple stakeholders and take ownership of assigned workload
  • Adaptability and experience with fast-cycle feedback
  • To be able to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends



Nice to have

  • Fluency in other languages
  • A degree in law or a STEM subject
  • A professional certification (e.g., ICA or ACAMS)
  • Familiarity with jurisdiction-specific financial regulations
  • Experience in crypto or blockchain analysis



Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday.


We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.


By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.



About the role

Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.


We’re looking for a Financial Crime Analyst to identify suspicious activity and ensure we’re treating customers fairly. You’ll be investigating internal SARs and complex cases by applying judgement, analytical skills, and solid decision-making to identify where grounds for suspicion of money laundering exist.


To support our 24/7 coverage, this role may include night and weekend shifts, which are fully compensated.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.



What you'll be doing

  • Reviewing, investigating, and reporting financial crime cases
  • Providing ongoing monitoring and resolving formal complaints and Financial Ombudsman Service complaints
  • Dealing appropriately with consent refusals following SAR submissions
  • Acting as a point of contact for law enforcement agencies in ongoing criminal investigations that commenced from a submitted SAR
  • Acting in accordance with written policies, procedures, and relevant legislation
  • Cooperating with other teams by providing professional and efficient front-line compliance support, seeking to improve company processes



What you'll need

  • A bachelor's degree (must be able to provide a certificate)
  • 3+ years in financial crime investigations, or 1+ years of SAR reporting experience
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (C1+ level)
  • Experience working in a regulated or policy-driven environment (e.g., financial institutions, law enforcement)
  • Experience with investigative methodologies, evidenced by the use of analytical tools (e.g., spreadsheets, filters, pivots, network charts)
  • The ability to work with multiple stakeholders and take ownership of assigned workload
  • Adaptability and experience with fast-cycle feedback
  • To be able to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends



Nice to have

  • Fluency in other languages
  • A degree in law or a STEM subject
  • A professional certification (e.g., ICA or ACAMS)
  • Familiarity with jurisdiction-specific financial regulations
  • Experience in crypto or blockchain analysis



Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday.


We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Senior AWS Cloud Infrastructure & Linux Engineer | Inglês Avançado

Se você gosta de desafios envolvendo Cloud Infrastructure, Linux, Automação e DevOps em escala corporativa , essa pode ser uma excelente oportunidade para dar o próximo passo na sua carreira.

title: Business Development & Marketing
description:
About iQIYI

iQIYI International is a global digital entertainment platform focused on Asian dramas, films, animation, variety shows and other content for international audiences. In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences.


Role purpose

Support iQIYI’s expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision.


Key responsibilities

1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70%

  • Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines.
  • Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials.
  • Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models.
  • Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models.
  • Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant iQIYI functions; final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters.
  • Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia.
  • Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators.
  • Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America.
  • Represent iQIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America.

2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30%

  • Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the iQIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers.
  • Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects.
  • Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines.
  • Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable.
  • Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations.



Required qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions.
  • Hands-on experience in B2B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects.
  • Fluent or native Portuguese.
  • Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills.
  • Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field.
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred.


Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms.
  • Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America.
  • Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners.
  • Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams.
  • Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models.
  • Mandarin Chinese.
  • Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage.


Employment conditions and benefits

  • Permanent CLT employment agreement.
  • Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law.
  • Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance.
  • Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance.
  • 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law.
  • Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto!

Na Flyover Idiomas, nosso diferencial está no processo de junção de alunos e professores, que visa aproveitar suas semelhanças, incluindo experiência e personalidade.

Estamos à procura de pessoas dedicadas e entusiasmadas para se juntarem à nossa equipe como professores de inglês remoto. Esta posição oferece a conveniência de trabalhar de qualquer lugar com horários flexíveis.


Sobre nós:  Somos uma escola de idiomas online comprometida em oferecer ensino de inglês de alta qualidade para alunos de todas as idades e contextos. Nossa missão é ensinar os alunos através de experiências de aprendizagem personalizadas, utilizando a abordagem comunicativa, com foco na fluência mais do que na precisão, selecionando materiais autênticos e relevantes, e integrando todas as quatro habilidades.


Visão geral da posição

  • Lecionar aulas de inglês, principalmente particulares ou em pequenos grupos.
  • Desenvolver planos de aula e atividades envolventes que atendam a diferentes necessidades de aprendizagem e níveis de proficiência, usando a abordagem comunicativa, focada na autonomia do aluno e na personalização da aula.
  • Participar de treinamentos, reuniões com nossos coordenadores e projetos diversos.
  • Fornecer feedback construtivo e ajudar os alunos a melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas.
  • Enviar relatórios das aulas para manter seus alunos e a escola atualizados sobre o andamento das mesmas.
  • Promover um ambiente de aprendizagem confortável e encorajador com foco no sucesso do alu no.


Formato

  • Contratação: Contrato com Microempreendedor Individual (MEI)
  • Local : Remoto
  • Carga Horária: Você define a sua própria agenda


Requisitos

  • Proficiência em inglês (mínimo C1)
  • Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial).
  • Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula.
  • Disponibilidade de pelo menos 25 horas/semana, com alguns horários após as 17h (horário de São Paulo).
  • Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal.

title: AI Annotator
description:
About the Project

We are looking for native or near-native speakers to support an AI data annotation and translation project. The role involves reviewing, translating, and annotating content according to detailed guidelines to help improve the quality and accuracy of AI systems.


Project Details

  • Work Type: Freelance / Remote
  • Commitment: Approx. 20 hours per week
  • Duration: 2 Months
  • Languages (required): Portuguese, English
  • Project Area: AI Data Annotation & Translation
  • Assessments: 2 mandatory assessments
  • Schedule: Flexible, based on project needs and your availability


Key Responsibilities

  • Perform annotation and translation tasks
  • Review and classify content according to project-specific guidelines
  • Ensure annotations and translations are accurate, consistent, and contextually appropriate
  • Identify linguistic, grammatical, cultural, and contextual issues
  • Follow project instructions and quality standards carefully
  • Maintain consistency across large volumes of data
  • Complete assigned tasks within the required timelines
  • Participate in quality checks and incorporate feedback when required


Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in Portuguese (native or near-native level preferred)
  • Good working proficiency in English
  • Excellent understanding of language, grammar, syntax, and cultural context
  • Previous experience in translation, data annotation, content review, linguistic evaluation, or AI/ML data projects is preferred
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow detailed guidelines
  • Ability to work independently in a remote/freelance environment
  • Reliable internet connection and access to a computer/laptop
