title: AI Engineer
description:
Job Title: AI Engineer

Location: LATAM – Remote

Mode: Contract

Job Description:

Builds the agents, models, and integrations on the platform's templates — the hands that turn use cases into production systems.


What they'll do

  • Build and ship LLM-powered agents and workflows on the paved path (templates, pipeline, guardrails)
  • Write and run evals for everything built; no system ships without passing its suite
  • Integrate with GoodRx systems and data sources; instrument for cost and quality telemetry
  • Pair with business users to iterate quickly inside bounded scopes


Must have

  • 8+ years software engineering; 2.5+ building LLM applications in production (agents, RAG, tool use)
  • Strong Python/TypeScript; API craftsmanship; prompt and context engineering that survives contact with users
  • Can write LLM evals as part of building — non-negotiable
  • Ships fast without skipping guardrails


Nice to have

  • Retrieval/IR depth (for assistant-facing work); healthcare data handling; cost-optimization experience

title: Senior Marketing Designer
description:
Senior Marketing Designer

Shoplift · Remote · August 2026



About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind — making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15–30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.

Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants, with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores — from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of fewer than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners — handpicked by Shopify themselves, and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.

We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem — not just a vendor.

We're a small team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.



The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the lead magnets, ad systems, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters — not through words, but through visuals that show rather than tell.

This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2B SaaS marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert.

Here's what makes it unique. We're a B2B SaaS company that doesn't take itself too seriously — our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the SaaS. Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, and that's one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps that balance.

And here's the creative challenge. We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world — the people running growth at KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work instantly, because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by \"brand recognizes brand\" and want to make marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.

You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success to surface the stories and data that make our marketing resonate.



This is a range role, not a specialty role

You are the marketing design function. In a given week you might build a paid social system, a 40-page ebook, a feature landing page, a motion loop, an email header, and a partner one-pager — and there's nobody to hand the unglamorous parts to.

That means we care more about range across disciplines than a single deep specialty. Brand, campaign, web, motion, presentation, systems, and production all show up in the job. You won't be equally strong in all of them, and we don't expect that. We do expect you to know exactly where you're weakest and to have a real strategy for covering it.



How you'll work: AI as production infrastructure

This is not a bonus point. It's core to how this role operates.

We expect you to use AI to move faster and raise your ceiling — to explore more directions before committing, to kill the tedious parts of production, and to ship volume that a designer working manually simply can't match. What we're looking for isn't enthusiasm about tools. It's evidence that you've built systems you reuse: skills, template and batch pipelines, generation workflows tuned to a specific brand, whatever your version of that looks like.

Just as important: we want someone with the judgment to know where AI makes work worse, and the conviction to not use it there. Taste doesn't get outsourced to a model. If your AI answer is a list of tool names, this isn't the right role for you.

You'll have real latitude to invent this. Nobody here is going to hand you a workflow.



What You'll Do

Marketing creative & campaign assets

  • Design static ad systems for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
  • Create lead magnets — ebooks, guides, one-pagers — that look premium and convert
  • Build comparison visuals (before/after, with Shoplift vs. without) that make value instantly clear
  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Build templated creative systems others can adapt without breaking brand consistency

Brand & sales materials

  • Create feature landing page designs that follow our show-don't-tell philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale

Product marketing visualization

  • Design materials that highlight the excellence of the app itself
  • Create motion graphics and dynamic visuals for web
  • Build and maintain a library of reusable marketing assets

You'll contribute immediately — shipping assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.



What success looks like

By day 30: You've shipped real assets in market, and you can articulate our brand's edges — what's on-brand, what's a near-miss, and why.

By day 90: You've built at least one system (a creative template, an AI-assisted production pipeline) that makes the next hundred assets faster than the first ten. You know which of your work performed and which didn't.



You're a Great Fit If…

Must-haves

  • 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2B SaaS portfolio
  • Expert-level Figma proficiency — you build organized, scalable systems
  • Demonstrated, systematic use of AI in your design production. You can walk us through what you've built, reuse, and where you deliberately don't use it
  • Range across disciplines — brand, campaign, web, presentation, and production, with the honesty to name your weakest area
  • You understand brand nuance: the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
  • Template-based thinking — you create assets others can adapt and reuse
  • English proficiency for daily collaboration with a US-based team
  • A portfolio demonstrating marketing design with personality and sophistication (applications without a portfolio won't be considered)

Nice-to-haves

  • Motion design or animation
  • Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
  • Performance marketing background — you understand what makes an ad convert
  • You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention



How we work, and who does well here

High agency. You'll get a brief and a deadline, not art direction. The best people here notice what's missing and go build it before anyone asks.

Real accountability. You'll know how your work performed — not because someone emails you a report, but because you went and got the numbers. \"It looked great\" is not a result.

Creative conviction. We want the risky option on the table, argued for. We also want you to let it go when the data disagrees. Move fast, iterate on feedback, don't take revisions personally.



What We Offer

  • Salary: $45,000 – $55,000 USD annually
  • Flexible remote work
  • Generous time off policy
  • Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
  • Build your portfolio with high-quality B2B SaaS work that stands out
  • Collaborate with our product designer on maintaining design consistency across brand and product



How to Apply

Apply through this link — applications without a portfolio won't be considered:

You'll be asked to include:

  • Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2B SaaS marketing work)
  • One asset you're proud of (3–4 sentences): show us a marketing asset and tell us why it worked.
  • How you use AI (3–4 sentences): describe one AI workflow you've built and reuse. What did it change about your output — speed, quality, volume, or all three? Where do you refuse to use it?

We're excited to meet you.

We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem — not just a vendor.

We're a small team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.



The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the lead magnets, ad systems, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters — not through words, but through visuals that show rather than tell.

This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2B SaaS marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert.

Here's what makes it unique. We're a B2B SaaS company that doesn't take itself too seriously — our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the SaaS. Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, and that's one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps that balance.

And here's the creative challenge. We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world — the people running growth at KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work instantly, because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by \"brand recognizes brand\" and want to make marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.

Marketing creative & campaign assets

  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Build templated creative systems others can adapt without breaking brand consistency

Brand & sales materials

  • Create feature landing page designs that follow our show-don't-tell philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale

Product marketing visualization

  • Design materials that highlight the excellence of the app itself
  • Create motion graphics and dynamic visuals for web
  • Build and maintain a library of reusable marketing assets

You'll contribute immediately — shipping assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.



What success looks like

By day 30: You've shipped real assets in market, and you can articulate our brand's edges — what's on-brand, what's a near-miss, and why.

By day 90: You've built at least one system (a creative template, an AI-assisted production pipeline) that makes the next hundred assets faster than the first ten. You know which of your work performed and which didn't.



You're a Great Fit If…

Must-haves

  • 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2B SaaS portfolio
  • Expert-level Figma proficiency — you build organized, scalable systems
  • Demonstrated, systematic use of AI in your design production. You can walk us through what you've built, reuse, and where you deliberately don't use it
  • Range across disciplines — brand, campaign, web, presentation, and production, with the honesty to name your weakest area
  • You understand brand nuance: the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
  • Template-based thinking — you create assets others can adapt and reuse
  • English proficiency for daily collaboration with a US-based team
  • A portfolio demonstrating marketing design with personality and sophistication (applications without a portfolio won't be considered)

Nice-to-haves

  • Motion design or animation
  • Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
  • Performance marketing background — you understand what makes an ad convert
  • You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention



How we work, and who does well here

High agency. You'll get a brief and a deadline, not art direction. The best people here notice what's missing and go build it before anyone asks.

Real accountability. You'll know how your work performed — not because someone emails you a report, but because you went and got the numbers. \"It looked great\" is not a result.

Creative conviction. We want the risky option on the table, argued for. We also want you to let it go when the data disagrees. Move fast, iterate on feedback, don't take revisions personally.



What We Offer

  • Salary: $45,000 – $55,000 USD annually
  • Flexible remote work
  • Generous time off policy
  • Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
  • Build your portfolio with high-quality B2B SaaS work that stands out
  • Collaborate with our product designer on maintaining design consistency across brand and product



How to Apply

Apply through this link — applications without a portfolio won't be considered:

You'll be asked to include:

  • Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2B SaaS marketing work)
  • One asset you're proud of (3–4 sentences): show us a marketing asset and tell us why it worked.
  • How you use AI (3–4 sentences): describe one AI workflow you've built and reuse. What did it change about your output — speed, quality, volume, or all three? Where do you refuse to use it?

We're excited to meet you.

title: Client Lead Staffing (Bilingual)
description:
Position Overview


We are seeking an entrepreneurial and commercially driven Client Recruiting Lead to spearhead client acquisition, relationship management, and recruitment delivery across Brazil. This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for winning new business, presenting recruitment solutions, managing client engagements, and ensuring successful execution of recruitment projects.

The ideal candidate combines strong business development skills with hands-on recruiting expertise. They are comfortable opening doors, closing new clients, leading client presentations, managing search delivery teams, and personally contributing to candidate sourcing and recruitment efforts when needed.


This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a growth environment, enjoys building client partnerships, and is willing to roll up their sleeves to ensure exceptional recruitment outcomes.


Key Responsibilities


Business Development & Client Growth


  • Identify, develop, and close new client relationships across Brazil.
  • Build a strong pipeline of prospective clients through networking, referrals, market mapping, and outbound business development activities.
  • Present recruitment solutions, service offerings, and engagement models to prospective clients.
  • Negotiate commercial terms and secure signed recruitment engagements.
  • Develop strategic account plans to grow and expand client relationships.
  • Identify opportunities to cross-sell additional recruitment, talent advisory, RPO, executive search, or consulting services.


Client Relationship Management


  • Serve as the primary point of contact for key client accounts.
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with hiring managers, HR leaders, and executive stakeholders.
  • Conduct intake meetings to understand hiring needs, organizational structures, and business objectives.
  • Provide market intelligence, talent insights, and hiring recommendations.
  • Maintain high levels of client satisfaction and retention.


Recruitment Delivery Leadership


  • Oversee the end-to-end recruitment process across assigned client engagements.
  • Ensure delivery teams meet quality, timeline, and hiring objectives.
  • Manage recruitment workflows, candidate pipelines, and client communications.
  • Monitor key performance indicators and ensure successful project outcomes.
  • Lead recruitment strategy discussions and hiring progress reviews with clients.


Hands-On Recruitment


  • Personally manage and deliver key searches when required.
  • Conduct candidate sourcing, screening, interviewing, and assessment activities.
  • Support recruiters on difficult or high-priority assignments.
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines within targeted industries and functions.
  • Ensure an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.


Market & Leadership Contributions


  • Stay informed on labor market trends, compensation benchmarks, and hiring practices within Brazil.
  • Provide thought leadership and recruitment expertise both internally and externally.
  • Support process improvement initiatives and best practices across recruitment operations.
  • Mentor and develop recruiting team members as the business grows.


Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 7+ years of recruitment, executive search, RPO, staffing, or talent acquisition experience.
  • Demonstrated success in business development and client acquisition.
  • Experience leading recruitment engagements and managing client relationships.
  • Proven ability to close recruitment projects and generate new business revenue.
  • Strong understanding of full-cycle recruitment and talent acquisition best practices.
  • Excellent presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and professional proficiency in English.
  • Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience within a recruitment agency, executive search firm, or RPO environment.
  • Existing network of corporate HR and business leaders in Brazil.
  • Experience scaling client accounts and cross-selling additional service offerings.
  • Leadership experience managing recruiters or recruitment delivery teams.
  • Knowledge of recruiting across multiple industries and functional disciplines.


Success Measures


  • New client acquisition and revenue generation.
  • Client retention and account growth.
  • Cross-selling and expansion of existing accounts.
  • Successful delivery of recruitment engagements.
  • Time-to-fill, quality-of-hire, and client satisfaction metrics.
  • Growth of the Brazil business and market presence.

title: Professor de alemão
description:
Oportunidade para um(a) professora(a) de alemão, que busca trabalhar de forma remota e flexível, se desprendendo do método tradicional de ensino e impactando positivamente na vida de centenas de alunos e alunas.


Buscamos um profissional paciente, responsável e proativo. Não é necessário ter experiência.


Tipo de contratação: PJ;

Nível de proficiência: B2 ou acima.

Horário: a combinar.

Salário: a combinar.

Local: Remoto.


Atividades principais:

• Aulas de Conversação e Plantões de Dúvidas, conforme metodologia do curso.


Requisitos Necessários:

• Proficiência de Nível B2 ou acima.

• Experiência intermediária com pacote Office.

• Agilidade;

• Boa comunicação.

• Paciência;


Habilidades Diferenciais (mas não obrigatórias):

• Graduado(a) ou graduando(a) em Letras.

• Experiência com viagens/intercâmbio para países falantes de alemão;

• Experiência com produção de conteúdo para redes sociais.


Quem Somos:

A GC Ensino é uma empresa especializada em lançamentos digitais de infoprodutos, idealizadora da escola de alemão \"Missão Alemão\" e do curso \"Programa Deutsch Pro\".


Isso significa que transformamos vidas através do conhecimento!


Nosso papel é promover a educação e impactar positivamente milhares de pessoas ao redor do mundo, através do idioma alemão. E tudo isso utilizando uma ferramenta que mudou a forma com que nós, seres humanos, nos comunicamos: a internet!

title: Project Management Officer
description:
Job Title: PMO Analyst

Location: Brazil – Remote

Employment Type: Contract (CST or EST Time Zone)


Job Summary

We are seeking a PMO Analyst with 3–6 years of experience supporting program and project management in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate will maintain integrated project plans, manage RAID logs, build executive dashboards, and prepare steering committee materials. Experience with Excel and project management tools such as Smartsheet, Jira, or MS Project is required. Life sciences industry experience is a strong advantage.

Required Skills

  • 3–6 years of PMO, project coordination, or program analytics experience
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel
  • Experience with Smartsheet, Jira, MS Project, or similar PM tools
  • Dashboard creation and project reporting
  • RAID log management and project planning
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills

title: Freelancer  Gestão de Projetos Jr.
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Freelancer para Gestão de Projetos Jr. com foco em entregas de tecnologia e produtos digitais.


Atribuições:


● Auxiliar no planejamento e priorização do backlog através de reuniões semanais

com equipe interna, estimando esforço e, por fim, o fechamento da sprint semanal.

Em seguida, alinhamento da mesma com o cliente.

● Receber e entender o briefing do cliente e, a partir disso, verificar a necessidade do

debriefing. Disseminar o briefing recebido para as demais áreas, através de reunião

de kickoff com toda a equipe necessária.

● Atualizar, controlar e mapear as atividades do time, reportando sempre a gestão as

atividades e entregas da semana.

● Garantir que os processos sejam respeitados, e as plataformas (internas e do

cliente) estejam sempre atualizadas e fazer com que os prazos pré acordados sejam

atendidos.

● Garantir que as entregas estejam de acordo com o briefing, fazendo a validação

interna antes de dividir com o cliente.

● Manter boa comunicação e transparência com cliente e áreas internas;

● Participar ativamente das atividades, discussões e cerimônias de gestão (daily,

planning, review).

● Organizar e alinhar a rede e seus materiais, acompanhando sempre se as entregas

estão sendo colocadas nessa plataforma.


Requisitos


● Familiaridade com ferramentas de metodologia ágil;

● Conhecimentos em keynote, excel e power point;

● Aptidão com ambiente digital e tecnologias;

● Aptidão para resolução de problemas;

● Excelente habilidade de comunicação.



Contrato como Pessoa Jurídica

Duração de 90 dias

title: Analista de Farmacovigilância - Sênior
description:
Oportunidade para atuar na Libbs empresa brasileira consolidada do segmento Farmacêutico.

Segue abaixo informações da posição:


Tipo de Vaga: Temporário - Projeto por tempo determinado.

Horário de Trabalho: de segunda a sexta - Horário flexível entrada das 07:00 ás 09:00 e saída das 16:00 ás 18:00;

Local de Trabalho: Brasil

Modelo de Atuação: 100% Home office.

O QUE VOCÊ IRÁ FAZER:

• Atuar na avaliação e monitoramento de dados de segurança de medicamentos comercializados, assegurando o cumprimento das regulamentações nacionais e internacionais de Farmacovigilância.

•Conduzir avaliações de segurança, análises de tendência, detecção de sinais e apoiar a elaboração de avaliações benefício-risco dos produtos.

•Apoiar a elaboração, revisão e implementação de procedimentos, instruções de trabalho e fluxos relacionados ao Sistema de Farmacovigilância.

•Participar de projetos estratégicos relacionados ao desenvolvimento de novos produtos, contribuindo com avaliações de segurança e definições de processos de farmacovigilância.

•Atuar junto a parceiros externos e empresas parceiras, garantindo alinhamento técnico, troca de informações e cumprimento dos acordos de farmacovigilância.

•Contribuir para a elaboração de avaliações benefício-risco, análises de segurança e atividades de detecção de sinais.

•Apoiar auditorias, inspeções regulatórias e processos de due diligence relacionados à área.

•Participar da estruturação e melhoria contínua dos processos de farmacovigilância, promovendo qualidade, rastreabilidade e confiabilidade dos dados.

•Acompanhar cronogramas, entregas e demandas relacionadas aos projetos sob sua responsabilidade.

O QUE É NECESSÁRIO:

• Formação: Ensino superior completo em Farmácia ou áreas correlatas da Saúde

• Experiência: Em avaliação e gerenciamento de casos de segurança e atividades de monitoramento de segurança de medicamentos.

Vivência em gestão de projetos, implantação ou melhoria de processos.

Experiência em interação com áreas multidisciplinares e parceiros externos.

Conhecimento das regulamentações nacionais e internacionais aplicáveis às Boas Práticas de Farmacovigilância (RDC 406/2020, GVP, ICH e demais normas aplicáveis).

• Inglês avançado - conversação.

Caso tenha interesse, disponibilidade e requisitos necessários, finalize sua candidatura!

O Grupo Soulan Recursos Humanos espera contribuir em breve com sua trajetória profissional.

title: Digital Operations Analyst
description:
About Us:

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. At Mosaic, we design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the puzzle’s story. We are a fast-paced startup built by ex-Uber and Amazon employees. Check our website for more information:


Role Description

We’re looking for a process-oriented, analytical, and detail-oriented Digital Operations Analyst to join our growing team. In this role, you will work closely with the Planning, Analytics and Process Optimization Associate Director to provide analytical support across the company. You will also support digital operations. 


Role Responsibilities

Analytics :

  • Analyze e-commerce performance, including orders, conversion rates, revenue, customer behavior, and product performance 
  • Monitor and analyze digital operations across e-commerce, marketing, customer experience, and internal platforms
  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Operations, Customer Support, Finance, and Leadership to track KPIs and solve operational issues
  • Run cost benefit analysis of various workstreams
  • Analyze project and campaign performance
  • Support the Planning, Analytics and Process Optimization Associate Director in various ad-hoc analyses to support business decisions and strategic projects


Digital and E-commerce Operations:

  • Manage the sort of products on our website.
  • Project management of workstreams that are interdepartmental in nature
  • Manage analytics related audits of digital operations


Qualifications:

  • Proficiency in both written and spoken English
  • Bachelor’s degree in Analytics or related field 
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.
  • Attention to detail and a data-driven approach to problem-solving.
  • Basic to intermediate understanding of E-commerce platforms and website maintenance.
  • Deep experience working with Google Sheets or Excel is required.


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment:

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Better Together: We believe in contributing creatively and openly, helping others, and championing our people and customers.
  • Owner’s Mindset: We work diligently, seek out problems, take a bias for action, and own our mistakes.
  • Quality and Craftsmanship: We take pride in what we do and value quality in our work and products. 
  • Process Orientation: We show our work, think ahead, and seek continuous improvement. 
  • Moving Quickly: We are proactive people who take initiative and get things done in a timely manner.
  • Doing the Right Thing: We act with integrity and own our actions.


How to Apply:

Interested candidates must submit their resumes in English (Resumes in other languages will not be considered).

title: (Sr.) Director, Regulatory Affairs (Brazil)
description:
We are partnered with a company that is seeking an experienced (Sr.) Director of Regulatory Affairs to lead the development and execution of global regulatory strategies supporting the clinical development and commercialization of innovative therapies. This individual will play a key role in regulatory planning, submission strategy, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure successful interactions with global health authorities.


Responsibilites:

  • Develop and execute global regulatory strategies to support product development, clinical trials, and marketing approvals.
  • Provide regulatory guidance to cross-functional teams and ensure alignment with overall development and business objectives.
  • Lead the planning, preparation, authoring, and review of regulatory submissions to global health authorities, including the FDA, EMA, and other international agencies.
  • Support regulatory submissions across the product lifecycle, including INDs, CTAs, NDAs, BLAs, and MAAs.
  • Ensure regulatory documentation is accurate, complete, compliant with global regulatory requirements, and delivered within established timelines.
  • Monitor regulatory deliverables, identify potential risks, and proactively implement mitigation strategies to support submission timelines.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams, external vendors, and regulatory operations to support submission planning, publishing, and document management activities.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of regulatory processes, document standards, submission workflows, and regulatory systems.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required
  • Master’s Degree in life sciences discipline preferred
  • 7+ years experience in drug development and regulatory affairs
  • Must have experience with regulatory submission documents

title: Value Consultant
description:
About the engagement

Allari, an IT services firm, is running a NetSuite fit assessment for a mid-market consumer products company that sells through major retailers and Amazon. We are looking for a Value Consultant to build the total cost of ownership analysis and the business case behind the assessment's recommendation.


What you will do

You will turn NetSuite's licensing structure and the solution architect's sizing into a defensible, subscription-inclusive, multi-year cost model, benchmark it against the client's current on-premise ERP, and shape the result into an executive business case.


Responsibilities

  • Build a subscription-inclusive, multi-year NetSuite total cost of ownership model, covering the base platform, seats by type, modules, SuiteCloud Plus, sandbox, and connectors
  • Model implementation, integration, and ongoing operation costs, including run-rate and annual escalation
  • Build the comparison baseline for staying on the current ERP, on the same basis and time horizon
  • Identify and price automation and AI capabilities that carry additional licensing
  • Collect and normalize non-binding budgetary implementation estimates from qualified resources
  • Assemble an executive business case that supports the recommendation


Required experience

  • Experience in ERP value consulting or value engineering, or in ERP total-cost and business-case development
  • Working knowledge of NetSuite licensing and pricing structure: editions, user and seat types, modules, and options
  • Strong financial-modeling skills and the ability to build clear, defensible cost models
  • Ability to present a business case to executive stakeholders


Preferred

  • NetSuite value-engineering or pre-sales value-consulting background
  • Consumer products, retail, or wholesale-distribution experience
  • Experience comparing SaaS ERP against on-premise total cost


Engagement terms

  • Contract role, remote
  • Independent contractor, engaged directly by Allari
  • Competitive contract rate, commensurate with experience


How to apply: Apply here with your resume in English.

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)


Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Contratação: PJ


Buscamos por um(a) Senior Product Designer (UX/UI) para atuar na concepção e evolução de produtos digitais, contribuindo para a criação de experiências intuitivas, consistentes e centradas no usuário.


Responsabilidades

– Liderar a concepção e evolução de interfaces e experiências digitais, garantindo usabilidade, consistência e geração de valor para o usuário.

– Estruturar fluxos, jornadas e navegação dos produtos, proporcionando experiências intuitivas e eficientes.

– Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com Product Managers, times de Engenharia e demais stakeholders.

– Criar wireframes, fluxos, protótipos e especificações de UI.

– Validar soluções por meio de testes de usabilidade e análise do comportamento dos usuários.

– Apresentar e defender decisões de design junto a públicos técnicos e não técnicos.


Requisitos

– Experiência comprovada como Product Designer, UX Designer ou UI Designer em produtos digitais.

– Experiência com UX/UI e desenvolvimento de experiências centradas no usuário, considerando usabilidade e boas práticas de design.

– Experiência na criação de fluxos, jornadas e protótipos de média e alta fidelidade.

– Domínio de Figma, incluindo componentes, Auto Layout e prototipação.

– Conhecimento em Design Systems e trabalho com componentes reutilizáveis.

– Boa comunicação e capacidade de apresentar e defender decisões de design junto a diferentes stakeholders.

– Inglês avançado.

title: Consultor(a) Júnior de Soluções | Pré-Vendas Técnico
description:
🚀 Sobre a Sinergis


Somos uma consultoria especializada em ClickUp e outras ferramentas de produtividade, ajudando empresas a transformarem seus processos de trabalho. Trabalhamos com clientes de diversos segmentos, desde startups até grandes corporações, desenhando soluções sob medida que geram resultado real. Se você curte tecnologia, organização e quer crescer rápido em um ambiente que valoriza autonomia e aprendizado constante, essa vaga foi feita pra você.


Sobre a Oportunidade


Estamos buscando um(a) Consultor(a) Júnior de Soluções para integrar nosso time Comercial, atuando na frente de pré-vendas técnico .


Você será o elo entre o time de vendas e a entrega técnica: vai acompanhar leads durante todo o funil comercial, participar de reuniões técnicas, montar demonstrações personalizadas e ajudar nossos clientes a enxergarem o valor real das soluções que oferecemos, principalmente no ClickUp .


Não precisa ser expert. Precisa ter curiosidade, vontade de aprender e facilidade pra se comunicar. A gente te desenvolve no resto. 


O que você vai fazer no dia a dia


  • Participar de reuniões técnicas com leads junto ao time comercial, entendendo processos, dores e necessidades de cada potencial cliente.
  • Montar Provas de Conceito (PoC) : criar demonstrações customizadas no ClickUp (e outras ferramentas) mostrando como a solução resolve o problema real do cliente.
  • Acompanhar períodos de teste (Trial) : garantir que o lead tenha a melhor experiência durante os testes, tirando dúvidas e ajudando na configuração inicial.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente as negociações: ajudar a quebrar objeções técnicas e validar a viabilidade do que está sendo proposto.
  • Qualificar oportunidades : identificar se o cliente tem fit com nossas soluções e como podemos gerar mais valor.
  • Estudar e se atualizar constantemente sobre ClickUp , produtividade e metodologias de gestão.


✅ O que você precisa ter


  • Conhecimento em ClickUp : não precisa ser avançado, mas você precisa conhecer a ferramenta, já ter usado em projetos reais e ter curiosidade pra se aprofundar.
  • Boa comunicação : saber se expressar com clareza em reuniões, ter escuta ativa e conseguir traduzir coisas complexas em linguagem simples.
  • Noções de gestão de projetos : entender conceitos básicos de métodos ágeis (Kanban, Scrum), fluxos de trabalho e organização de processos.
  • Perfil investigativo : gostar de fazer perguntas, entender problemas e pensar em soluções, mesmo quando o cliente não sabe explicar exatamente o que precisa.
  • Organização e autonomia : capacidade de gerenciar suas próprias demandas e acompanhar múltiplos leads simultaneamente.


⭐ Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)


  • Certificações do ClickUp (ClickUp Expert, Admin, etc.)
  • Experiência com Monday.com, Notion ou outras ferramentas de produtividade
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de integração (Zapier, Make, n8n)
  • Experiência anterior com consultoria, implantação de sistemas ou suporte técnico
  • Noções de vendas B2B (funil de vendas, qualificação de leads, jornada do cliente)
  • Ter estruturado algum projeto ou workspace complexo no ClickUp


O que oferecemos

﻿

  • Crescimento acelerado : você vai aprender diretamente com especialistas e terá acesso a treinamentos internos constantes.
  • Exposição a diferentes negócios : cada cliente é um case novo, você vai conhecer dezenas de operações e mercados diferentes.
  • Trabalho 100% remoto : flexibilidade total de localização.
  • Ambiente colaborativo : time pequeno, próximo, sem burocracia, onde sua opinião importa desde o dia 1.
  • Evolução rápida : possibilidade real de crescer para Consultor Pleno e Sênior conforme seu desenvolvimento.


Obs: Se possível, inclua um breve relato (texto ou vídeo de até 2 min) sobre: Um projeto ou fluxo que você já montou/organizou no ClickUp OU por que você acredita que seria um bom fit para essa posição.

title: Editor de Vídeo (Remoto)
description:
Editor de Vídeo

Vaga Remota | porém morar em Blumenau ou região


Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Editor(a) de Vídeo que já tenha vivência na área para dar ritmo e narrativa aos nossos conteúdos! 

Se você tem experiência em edição, sabe contar uma história com corte, trilha e motion, e tem interesse ou alguma vivência em captação (câmera, luz, áudio), seu lugar é aqui.


O que esperamos de você?

  • Captação: Operar câmeras, configurar iluminação e garantir a qualidade do áudio em gravações de estúdio e externas.
  • Edição: Editar e pós-produzir vídeos educacionais, garantindo qualidade e fluidez no conteúdo.
  • Motion Graphics: Criar letterings, transições e animações básicas para elevar o nível das produções.
  • Sound Design: Ajustar áudio, iluminação e efeitos especiais conforme necessário.
  • Curadoria: Auxiliar na decupagem de materiais e organização de arquivos (asset management).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com roteiristas e designers para alinhar o vídeo com a identidade visual e didática da empresa.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre novas tendências, ferramentas de edição de vídeo e uso de IA no dia a dia.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Experiência prévia consolidada em edição de vídeos (perfil junior/pleno).
  • Domínio de softwares de edição como Adobe Premiere, After Effects , entre outros. (não conta CapCut)
  • Interesse ou vivência inicial em captação (câmera, iluminação, áudio) é esperado.
  • Conhecimento de animação e motion graphics é um diferencial.
  • Boa compreensão de narrativa visual e ritmo.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e cumprir prazos com autonomia.


A jornada de trabalho é de segunda a sexta-feira, e ocorre de forma remota, porém, devido aos trabalhos de captação de vídeos é necessário morar em Blumenau ou regiões próximas e ter disponibilidade para viagens.

title: Consulting Partner
description:
ERA Group, a global leader in cost management and business optimisation, is looking for an entrepreneurial Partner to join our international network of consultants.

This is not a traditional consultancy role — it’s a chance to run your own practice within a global brand, with the freedom to shape your market, build your team, and grow your client base, while backed by ERA’s proven methodologies, tools, and worldwide community.


What You’ll Do


  • Lead cost optimisation, procurement, and performance improvement programmes across industries
  • Build and grow your client portfolio through business development and long-term partnerships
  • Take ownership of your practice’s strategic direction, go-to-market approach, and team leadership
  • Work directly with C-level clients to deliver measurable savings and transformation

What You Bring


  • Extensive consulting or senior leadership experience in cost management, procurement, or performance improvement
  • A strong track record of client acquisition and project delivery
  • Deep expertise in one or more industries such as Pharma/Life Sciences, Energy/Utilities, Manufacturing, Consumer, or Logistics
  • Confidence in engaging with CxO-level stakeholders and leveraging your professional network
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with the ambition to grow a successful consulting practice

This is the ideal next step if you’re seeking less bureaucracy, more independence, and the chance to build something of your own within a global consultancy platform.

title: Customer Success
description:
About Foundey

Foundey (formerly Uitify) is an embedded product design partner for early-stage SaaS and AI startups based in the United States. We help founders improve product clarity, user experience, and go-to-market execution through senior design thinking combined with fast, high-quality execution.

We partner closely with ambitious startup teams to transform complex ideas into intuitive products, compelling narratives, and scalable digital experiences. Our work sits at the intersection of product strategy, design excellence, and business growth.


THE ROLE

In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for our clients, ensuring they get maximum value

from our compliance solutions while supporting smooth internal operations. You will work at the

intersection of client relationship management, process optimization, and regulatory knowledge —

making this an ideal position for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.


THE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Customer Success
  • Serve as the dedicated point of contact for a portfolio of clients, building trusted long-term

relationships

  • Onboard new clients by guiding them through platform setup, training, and initial compliance

workflows

  • Conduct regular check-ins, business reviews, and health assessments to track client

satisfaction and product adoption

  • Proactively identify at-risk accounts and develop retention strategies in collaboration with

Sales and Product teams

  • Gather and synthesize client feedback to inform product roadmap and service improvements

Operations & Process Support

  • Support internal operational processes including workflow documentation, project tracking,

and reporting

  • Maintain accurate client data and interaction records in the CRM system (Notion)
  • Assist in the development and refinement of SOPs, playbooks, and knowledge base content
  • Monitor deliverables and deadlines on behalf of clients, flagging risks proactively.
  • Compliance Support
  • Develop a working understanding of the regulatory frameworks relevant to our clients (e.g.,

US and International entity compliance)

  • Help complete orders for compliance related services such as business formations and

Annual filings ect.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • 4+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or operations
  • Exceptional written and verbal (English) communication skills with the ability to explain

complex concepts clearly

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and client accounts

simultaneously

  • Proficiency with Notion, Google and project management platforms is a plus
  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset with a high attention to detail
  • Experience supporting onboarding or implementation processes for software products


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will play a key role in shaping how an ambitious startup design partner communicates its value to the world.

Today, our biggest bottleneck is not delivery — it’s clarity. We are looking for someone who can help sharpen our story, accelerate our sales process, and build unmistakable positioning in a highly competitive market.

  • You’ll work directly with founders, influence business strategy, and have meaningful ownership over how Foundey grows, communicates, and wins clients.

description:
About Foundey

Foundey (formerly Uitify) is an embedded product design partner for early-stage SaaS and AI startups based in the United States. We help founders improve product clarity, user experience, and go-to-market execution through senior design thinking combined with fast, high-quality execution.

We partner closely with ambitious startup teams to transform complex ideas into intuitive products, compelling narratives, and scalable digital experiences. Our work sits at the intersection of product strategy, design excellence, and business growth.


THE ROLE

In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for our clients, ensuring they get maximum value

from our compliance solutions while supporting smooth internal operations. You will work at the

intersection of client relationship management, process optimization, and regulatory knowledge —

making this an ideal position for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.


THE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Customer Success
  • Serve as the dedicated point of contact for a portfolio of clients, building trusted long-term

relationships

  • Onboard new clients by guiding them through platform setup, training, and initial compliance

workflows

  • Conduct regular check-ins, business reviews, and health assessments to track client

satisfaction and product adoption

  • Proactively identify at-risk accounts and develop retention strategies in collaboration with

Sales and Product teams

  • Gather and synthesize client feedback to inform product roadmap and service improvements

Operations & Process Support

  • Support internal operational processes including workflow documentation, project tracking,

and reporting

  • Maintain accurate client data and interaction records in the CRM system (Notion)
  • Assist in the development and refinement of SOPs, playbooks, and knowledge base content
  • Monitor deliverables and deadlines on behalf of clients, flagging risks proactively.
  • Compliance Support
  • Develop a working understanding of the regulatory frameworks relevant to our clients (e.g.,

US and International entity compliance)

  • Help complete orders for compliance related services such as business formations and

Annual filings ect.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • 4+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or operations
  • Exceptional written and verbal (English) communication skills with the ability to explain

complex concepts clearly

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and client accounts

simultaneously

  • Proficiency with Notion, Google and project management platforms is a plus
  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset with a high attention to detail
  • Experience supporting onboarding or implementation processes for software products


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will play a key role in shaping how an ambitious startup design partner communicates its value to the world.

Today, our biggest bottleneck is not delivery — it’s clarity. We are looking for someone who can help sharpen our story, accelerate our sales process, and build unmistakable positioning in a highly competitive market.

  • You’ll work directly with founders, influence business strategy, and have meaningful ownership over how Foundey grows, communicates, and wins clients.

title: Talent Management
description:
Sobre a Flint

A Flint é um selo de edutainment que transforma educação em influência e influência em negócio. Criamos programas que misturam conteúdo, comunidade e inteligência aplicada para capacitar profissionais e empresas a usarem a linguagem das redes como ferramenta estratégica. 

Nossos projetos combinam storytelling, prática e pertencimento, com formatos digitais, linguagem viva e experiências pensadas para quem aprende fazendo. Trabalhamos com grandes marcas e criadores para transformar conhecimento em impacto real, ampliando vozes, repertórios e oportunidades


Sobre a posição

Na Flint, creators são parte central de muitos dos projetos que construímos para grandes marcas. Trabalhamos com diferentes perfis de talentos, creators independentes, empresários e agências, conectando essas relações a campanhas, conteúdos, experiências e projetos de longo prazo. Estamos procurando uma pessoa para assumir a frente de Talent Management , cuidando da relação entre a Flint e nosso ecossistema de creators e agências parceiras.


Essa pessoa será responsável por fazer a ponte entre Flint, creators, agências de talentos e nossos projetos para clientes , garantindo que toda essa relação aconteça de forma organizada, ágil e positiva.


É uma posição que combina relacionamento, negociação e operação . No dia a dia, essa pessoa vai participar desde os primeiros contatos com um creator ou sua agência, entendendo disponibilidade, interesse, escopo e valores, até a negociação, contratação e acompanhamento das entregas ao longo de uma campanha.


Também será responsável por garantir que todas as partes tenham clareza sobre briefings, escopo, prazos, aprovações, contratos, pagamentos e próximos passos , antecipando problemas e fazendo as conversas avançarem. Buscamos alguém capaz de construir boas relações com o mercado de creators . Alguém que saiba negociar sem desgastar uma parceria, cobrar sem perder proximidade e representar a Flint de maneira profissional em cada interação.


É uma posição para quem gosta de pessoas, mas também gosta de processo. Que consegue acompanhar muitas conversas ao mesmo tempo, sabe quando precisa acelerar uma negociação e entende que uma boa experiência para o creator também faz parte da qualidade do trabalho que entregamos aos nossos clientes.



Principais responsabilidades
  • Gerenciar o relacionamento cotidiano da Flint com creators, talentos, empresários e agências parceiras.
  • Conduzir contatos, consultas de disponibilidade e negociações comerciais com creators e seus representantes.
  • Negociar cachês, escopos, entregas, direitos de uso, exclusividades, prazos e demais condições de participação nos projetos.
  • Coordenar o fluxo entre creators, agências, time Flint e clientes durante campanhas e projetos.
  • Garantir que creators e parceiros recebam briefings, materiais, orientações e informações necessárias para cada entrega.
  • Acompanhar cronogramas, datas de publicação, aprovações, ajustes e demais milestones das campanhas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de atendimento, estratégia, conteúdo, produção e financeiro da Flint.
  • Organizar e acompanhar os processos de contratação, documentação, contratos, POs, notas fiscais e pagamentos junto às áreas responsáveis.
  • Manter informações, status e histórico das negociações e dos talentos organizados e atualizados.
  • Identificar riscos ou atrasos e atuar de forma proativa para destravar processos.
  • Ajudar a construir e fortalecer continuamente a rede de creators e parceiros da Flint.


Requisitos
  • Experiência com talent management, influencer marketing, creator partnerships, produção ou gestão de campanhas com creators.
  • Experiência em negociação comercial com talentos, empresários ou agências.
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação e relacionamento.
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes para acompanhar múltiplos projetos e negociações simultaneamente.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com cronogramas, processos e diferentes stakeholders.
  • Agilidade para resolver problemas e conduzir conversas de maneira autônoma.
  • Familiaridade com o funcionamento do mercado de creators, influenciadores e agências de talentos.


Diferenciais
  • Rede de relacionamento prévia com creators, empresários e agências.
  • Experiência com campanhas para grandes marcas.
  • Conhecimento sobre contratos de influência, direitos de imagem, mídia, exclusividade e licenciamento de conteúdo.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas e processos de gestão de creators e campanhas.
  • Interesse genuíno por creator economy, cultura digital e novas plataformas

title: Web Researcher
description:
Web Research Specialist - 8-week paid contract, remote (US)

8 weeks, full-time, remote. 40 hours/week with ~$20/hour. ~ around $6,400 for the full contract.


What you'll actually do:

Work with a frontier AI model - you'll help train it, test it, and make it smarter.

Think prompt engineering meets research: you talk to the AI, find where it gets stuck, and help fix that. No coding needed.


You're a fit if you:

  • Have 3+ years of research experience - you've dug through government databases, archives, registries, court records, PDFs
  • Cite the exact page, table, or section
  • Can pick up a topic you know nothing about and get to the bottom of it
  • Write clear, native-level English
  • Don't mind heavy documentation - the evidence trail is most of the work


Backgrounds we're looking for: reference librarians and archivists, investigative journalists and fact-checkers, OSINT / due diligence / KYC researchers, patent and legal-discovery searchers, genealogists, trivia and puzzle-hunt writers.


Bonus points: experience with LLM evaluation or red-teaming, comfort with JSON.


The details:

  • Contract, pay per task - no benefits or paid leave
  • 40 hours a week, with at least 4 hours overlapping Pacific time

title: Tariff Analyst
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Tariff Analyst for Gigawatt's Tariff Configuration team, the group that turns published utility tariffs into logic our platform can bill on. This is not data entry. What this team produces is the substrate the product runs on, and it is what a utility is trusting when it puts our software in front of its own customers. This team sits in Product, not in services. Accuracy is not a quality attribute of this role; it is the deliverable.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own tariff analysis and extraction: Work through published tariff books and pull out everything that determines what a customer is charged, including riders and supplemental charges. Organize it into clear, consistent structured data.
  • Own configuration workbooks: Build detailed workbooks that translate written tariff rules into explicit formulas and structured logic: price times quantity, billing demand rules, minimum charges, seasonal variations, and conditional calculations.
  • Own the rules in our engine: Configure tariff and regulatory logic in our visual, node-based rule builder. This is not programming. It is decomposing a written rule into steps and conditions and wiring them together, much like building a multi-tab Excel model where every input traces to an output.
  • Work from requirements, not just documents: Some rules come from a published tariff. Others come from a regulatory order, a client's business requirements, or a written spec. Read all of them and decide how the rule should actually behave, including at the boundaries where documents are silent or contradict each other.
  • Own validation: Build and run test cases that prove each configuration produces the intended result. Validate calculations against different use cases before anything reaches a client. This is the part of the job that separates good work from work that looks good.
  • Own client implementations: Take a client's tariffs from source documents through to a working, tested configuration in the platform. Walk through completed configurations with the team and with clients, investigate discrepancies, and document open questions for follow-up. A tariff that does not make sense is usually a finding, not a mistake.
  • Own the reference data: Maintain organized records of attribute values, lookup tables, and other inputs the formulas depend on, and keep them consistent across configurations.
  • Make the tooling better: Review AI-assisted extraction output, flag where it goes wrong, and help define what a correct extraction looks like for each utility. Your corrections are the training signal.
  • Support system integration: Prepare structured tariff data for loading into our systems and work with engineers to identify and resolve data and configuration issues.
  • Wear many hats: This is an early team. Take on new areas of ownership as the work and the tooling evolve.


Qualifications


Must Have

  • Advanced Excel and analytical modeling: You are fast and precise with complex formulas, lookups, structured datasets, and models with many interdependencies. If you enjoy building financial models in Excel, you will likely be good at this, and it is the same instinct that makes someone good in our rule builder.
  • Analytical problem solving: You can read a long, detailed, poorly structured document and break the written rules inside it into clean calculations, conditions, and structured logic.
  • Attention to detail: You can work line by line through large amounts of information and find the inconsistencies, gaps, and calculation errors others miss. In this role that is not a personality trait, it is the control that keeps incorrect bills from reaching customers.
  • Strong reading and written English: You will read dense US legal and regulatory English every day and write clear notes, questions, and documentation in English. This is a higher bar than conversational fluency and it is what we screen hardest on.
  • Organization: You can hold multiple tariffs, workbooks, source documents, open questions, and revisions in flight without losing the thread or drifting from the standard.
  • Technical literacy: Comfortable with structured data, system fields, and lookups. You do not need to write code. Familiarity with formats such as JSON is a plus.
  • AI-assisted workflows: You use AI tools to speed up research, extraction, and drafting, and you independently verify what they give you rather than trusting it.


Nice to Have

  • Rule-based domains: Experience with utility tariffs, energy markets, regulatory documents, financial models, or other complex rule-based datasets.
  • Requirements to configuration: Experience translating legal, regulatory, or business requirements into structured data or system configurations.
  • Builder-style tools: Experience with any visual or low-code rule builder, workflow tool, or configuration-driven software.
  • Data fluency: Familiarity with database concepts and structured data formats.


Location

  • Remote, Brazil.


US Team is based on Eastern and Pacific standard times.

title: Estágio em UI/UX Design
description:
Somos uma HRtech, e nossa missão é tornar as relações trabalhistas mais simples, eficientes e justas!


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa curiosa, colaborativa e com vontade de aprender para crescer com a gente!


Sua missão será poiar a criação e evolução das interfaces digitais da Nexti, contribuindo para experiências mais simples, intuitivas e alinhadas às necessidades dos nossos usuários. Você terá a oportunidade de aprender na prática, em parceria com os times de Design, Produto e Desenvolvimento.


🤓 Contamos com você para:

  • Apoiar a criação e melhoria de interfaces web e mobile, identificando problemas e oportunidades na experiência dos usuários;
  • Contribuir para a elaboração de propostas de interfaces e protótipos, com orientação do time;
  • Participar das rotinas de Produto e Design, colaborando em reuniões, discussões e atividades de ideação;
  • Realizar benchmarks e pesquisas de referências para identificar boas práticas e possibilidades de melhoria;
  • Apoiar a documentação de processos, decisões e aprendizados dos projetos.


REQUISITOS INDISPENSÁVEIS

O que buscamos:

  • Estar cursando graduação ou curso superior em Design, Design Digital, Design Gráfico, Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de design de interfaces (UI) e experiência do usuário (UX), adquirida em cursos, projetos acadêmicos ou pessoais;
  • Interesse em compreender as necessidades e os contextos dos usuários antes de propor soluções;
  • Clareza para comunicar ideias e disposição para colaborar com diferentes áreas;
  • Organização para lidar com atividades, informações e prioridades;
  • Proatividade, curiosidade e vontade de pesquisar, aprender e explorar novas referências.


✨ Será um diferencial:

Conhecimento básico em ferramentas de criação e prototipação de interfaces, preferencialmente Figma.


Sobre o portfólio:

Queremos conhecer sua forma de pensar e construir soluções! Seu portfólio não precisa ter projetos profissionais: projetos acadêmicos, pessoais ou estudos de caso que mostrem seu processo de design também são bem-vindos.


BENEFÍCIOS DA VAGA

️ VA/VR Ifood Benefícios no valor de R$48,26 diários;

Plano de saúde Bradesco;

🦷 Plano odontológico Bradesco.

Diferenciais #NextiPlayer:

Parceria com plano de saúde pet Guapeco;

🥳 R$100,00 no Ifood Benefícios + Day Off no aniversário;

WellHub (GymPass);

Cartão ECX Card de convênio farmácia;

Combo Nexti Flex com telemedicina, descontos em medicamentos, clube de descontos, seguro de vida e assistência funeral;

title: Senior Backend & AI Engineer (LATAM)
description:
Senior Backend & AI Engineer – Newsroom Transformation #3137


The Mission

Join a global Newsroom Transformation team working at the intersection of backend engineering, AI, and modern journalism technology. You’ll build scalable backend services while helping integrate AI capabilities into news systems, including LLM orchestration, fine-tuning, RAG, and intelligent automation.


You’ll collaborate with engineering teams and global stakeholders across multiple regions, helping transform how AI and automation power the next generation of newsroom platforms.


The Role

  • Backend Engineering: Build and maintain scalable services using Node.js, TypeScript, and Express.js within a distributed microservices environment.
  • AI & LLM Integration: Develop AI-powered services using LangChain, prompt engineering, LLM orchestration, and model fine-tuning.
  • RAG & NLP: Design and maintain Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) systems that ground AI outputs in trusted news content, with a strong understanding of embeddings and tokenization.
  • Model Strategy: Work with models such as Google Gemini, OpenAI, and Anthropic, selecting the right model based on performance, capabilities, and cost.
  • MLOps & Observability: Monitor AI and backend performance, including latency, throughput, errors, model quality, bias, toxicity, and concept drift.
  • Distributed Systems: Build secure integrations across internal REST/gRPC APIs, third-party vendors, and microservices.
  • DevOps & Infrastructure: Containerize services with Docker, manage CI/CD through CircleCI, and support infrastructure using Terraform.
  • Global Collaboration: Work closely with distributed engineering teams and stakeholders, presenting technical solutions and contributing to a highly collaborative, asynchronous environment.


The \"Must-Haves\"

  • Backend Engineering: 5+ years of professional backend development experience, ideally within distributed or microservices environments.
  • Node.js / TypeScript: Strong hands-on expertise with Node.js, TypeScript, and Express.js.
  • Python: Basic to intermediate Python experience for AI/ML development and model-related tasks.
  • LangChain: Hands-on experience with LangChain is mandatory.
  • AI / LLMs: Strong understanding of NLP, tokenization, embeddings, prompt engineering, LLM fine-tuning, and RAG architectures.
  • Cloud & DevOps: Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and at least one major cloud provider — Google Cloud preferred, AWS acceptable.
  • Microservices: Strong understanding of distributed and microservice architectures.
  • Global Collaboration: Comfortable working asynchronously across multiple time zones and collaborating with international stakeholders.


The \"Bonus\" Skills

  • Infrastructure as Code: Experience with Terraform.
  • Legacy Technologies: Familiarity with PHP.
  • Media & Publishing: Experience working in media, publishing, journalism, or newsroom technology.
  • GTM Experience: Exposure to startup environments and Go-to-Market strategies.
  • Advanced MLOps: Experience with model evaluation, validation, monitoring, and production AI/ML pipelines.


Personal Traits

  • AI-Minded Engineer: Excited about applying LLMs and emerging AI technologies to real-world products and workflows.
  • Backend Problem Solver: Enjoys building reliable, scalable services and solving complex distributed-system challenges.
  • Pragmatic Technologist: Able to evaluate models, tools, and approaches based on technical requirements, quality, and cost.
  • Strong Communicator: Comfortable presenting ideas, explaining technical decisions, and working with stakeholders across different regions.
  • Self-Driven: Thrives in a remote, asynchronous environment and takes initiative without constant direction.
  • Global Collaborator: Enjoys working across cultures, time zones, and engineering teams to deliver high-impact solutions.

description:

Buscamos um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Dados com sólida experiência em arquitetura de plataformas de dados em Google Cloud (GCP) e atuação em projetos de integração com Salesforce Data Cloud .


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Experiência com projetos de integração entre Google Cloud e Salesforce Data Cloud.
  • Projetar arquiteturas para plataformas de dados escaláveis, resilientes e de alta disponibilidade.

  • Definir e evoluir pipelines de dados e processos ETL/ELT.
  • Apoiar a definição de arquiteturas envolvendo Data Lake, Data Warehouse e demais componentes da plataforma de dados.
  • Projetar integrações utilizando APIs, REST e diferentes padrões de integração.
  • Definir modelos e estruturas de dados adequados aos diferentes casos de uso.
  • Garantir requisitos de qualidade, governança, segurança, escalabilidade e disponibilidade dos dados.
  • Avaliar tecnologias e padrões para evolução da plataforma de dados.
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de arquitetura sustentáveis e escaláveis.
  • Atuar em parceria com times de Data Engineering, Cloud, Salesforce, Tecnologia, Produto e Negócio.
  • Apoiar a evolução da arquitetura de dados e sua integração com o ecossistema Salesforce.


Requisitos

  • Domínio em arquitetura e serviços de dados no Google Cloud Platform (GCP), como BigQuery, Cloud Storage, orquestração de pipelines e gestão de identidade e acesso
  • Experiência no desenho e evolução de plataformas de dados em Cloud.
  • Conhecimento dos principais serviços e componentes de dados do Google Cloud e Salesforce Data Cloud
  • Experiência com integração de múltiplas fontes de dados e sistemas corporativos.
  • Experiência com ETL/ELT, pipelines de dados e Data Integration.
  • Conhecimento em Data Lake, Data Warehouse e modelagem de dados.
  • Experiência com APIs, REST e integração entre sistemas.
  • Conhecimento em governança, segurança, qualidade e disponibilidade de dados.
  • Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas escaláveis, resilientes e orientadas ao negócio.


Diferencial:

  • Certificações Google e/ ou Salesforce


Modelo de Trabalho e Contratação:

Contratação: PJ

Modelo de atuação: Remoto

Oportunidades de treinamento e cursos em tecnologias de dados.

Auxílio com certificações oficiais, com 100% de reembolso ou vouchers.

Parcerias com instituições de ensino para graduação, pós-graduação e idiomas.

title: Personal Injury Lead Intake Specialist
description:
Company Description Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential.

We are looking for a Personal Injury Lead Intake Specialist to handle inbound calls from potential personal injury clients. You will be the first point of contact for leads who have expressed interest in legal services, with the goal of understanding their situation, gathering the necessary information, qualifying the lead, and ensuring qualified prospects are properly transferred or scheduled with the appropriate attorney or legal team.


Responsibilities

  • Handle inbound calls from potential personal injury clients.
  • Speak with leads professionally and empathetically while building rapport.
  • Gather and accurately document information about the potential client's case.
  • Ask appropriate questions to determine whether the lead meets the required qualification criteria.
  • Follow established intake scripts, processes, and guidelines.
  • Accurately enter lead information into the CRM or designated systems.
  • Schedule qualified leads for consultations with the appropriate legal team.
  • Follow up with leads when necessary.
  • Maintain accurate records and ensure all lead information is handled confidentially.
  • Meet established performance and conversion targets.


Requirements

  • Excellent spoken and written English.
  • Strong communication and active-listening skills.
  • Previous experience in lead intake, call center, customer service, appointment setting, sales, or legal intake is preferred.
  • Comfortable handling a high volume of inbound calls.
  • Ability to ask questions, identify important information, and follow a structured qualification process.
  • Empathetic, professional, and confident when speaking with people who may be dealing with an injury.
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate data entry.
  • Comfortable working remotely and using CRM/call-management software.

title: Technical Lead
description:
Tech Lead Fullstack (Python + React/TypeScript) — Etern

A Etern está construindo uma plataforma de reconciliação longitudinal de dados de saúde, com foco em medicina preventiva. Nosso motor central é determinístico — não é um sistema de diagnóstico baseado em IA — o que traz implicações importantes de precisão, auditabilidade e conformidade regulatória (ANVISA). Estamos em um estágio inicial e buscamos uma liderança técnica prática, que já tenha colocado a mão na massa em produtos complexos e que se sinta confortável navegando ambiguidade.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento do produto, atuando lado a lado com o time de engenharia (não é um cargo apenas de gestão)
  • Ser a ponte entre médicos, fundadores e o time técnico, traduzindo necessidades clínicas e de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis
  • Tomar decisões de arquitetura para um sistema que lida com dados clínicos sensíveis e precisa de rastreabilidade e confiabilidade
  • Contribuir ativamente no backend (Python) e frontend (React/TypeScript)
  • Ajudar a estruturar processos técnicos e de produto em um ambiente de startup em fase inicial

O que buscamos:

  • Sólida experiência prática com Python e React/TypeScript
  • Vivência em liderança técnica, mesmo que informal (tech lead, staff engineer, ou similar)
  • Perfil comunicativo e entrepreneurial — alguém que consiga transitar entre conversas técnicas profundas e conversas com stakeholders não-técnicos
  • Experiência (atual ou passada) em healthtech é um diferencial importante
  • Conforto em ambientes ambíguos, típicos de startups em estágio inicial

Modelo: Remoto, Brasil

Tipo: Full-time

title: Designer Gráfico + Editor(a) de Vídeo | PJ com Inglês Fluente
description:
Sobre a Cremon

A Cremon Mortgage Experts é uma empresa especializada no mercado de mortgage nos Estados Unidos, oferecendo soluções para compra de imóveis, refinanciamento, home equity e outras necessidades de financiamento imobiliário.


Somos uma empresa em crescimento, com forte presença digital e atuação voltada a diferentes públicos e comunidades nos Estados Unidos. Comunicação, conteúdo e construção de marca têm um papel estratégico na nossa expansão.


Estamos ampliando nossa estrutura criativa e buscamos um(a) Designer Gráfico + Editor(a) de Vídeo para atuar na produção visual e audiovisual das marcas do Grupo Cremon .


Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) profissional criativo(a), organizado(a), tecnicamente preparado(a) e com excelente senso estético para transformar briefings, ideias, roteiros, fotos e vídeos em conteúdos visualmente fortes, atuais e alinhados à identidade das nossas marcas.


O profissional atuará junto à área de Marketing, trabalhando a partir de briefings, calendário de conteúdo, pautas, roteiros e direcionamentos criativos previamente definidos .


Seu foco será a execução criativa : transformar esses direcionamentos em peças gráficas, vídeos e materiais de comunicação finalizados e prontos para publicação.


Procuramos alguém que consiga equilibrar qualidade, agilidade e consistência , mas que também tenha repertório e autonomia técnica para propor boas soluções visuais.


Principais responsabilidadesDesign Gráfico

  • Criar peças gráficas para conteúdos digitais, campanhas e materiais de comunicação das marcas do Grupo Cremon;
  • Desenvolver posts, carrosséis, stories, infográficos, anúncios, peças institucionais e outros formatos de conteúdo;
  • Criar conceitos visuais a partir de briefings, referências e direcionamentos criativos;
  • Adaptar um mesmo conceito para diferentes formatos e necessidades, mantendo consistência visual;
  • Criar capas, thumbnails e outros elementos gráficos para conteúdos audiovisuais;
  • Realizar tratamento, composição e manipulação de imagens;
  • Trabalhar respeitando as identidades visuais e guidelines das marcas;
  • Desenvolver materiais especiais para campanhas, apresentações, eventos e outras demandas de comunicação quando necessário.

Edição de Vídeo

  • Editar conteúdos audiovisuais em diferentes formatos e durações;
  • Produzir desde vídeos curtos para redes sociais até conteúdos de aproximadamente 2 a 5 minutos ;
  • Trabalhar cortes, ritmo, narrativa e storytelling audiovisual;
  • Inserir e sincronizar legendas, trilhas, efeitos sonoros e elementos gráficos;
  • Criar títulos, transições, animações e motion graphics quando necessário;
  • Realizar tratamento básico de áudio, imagem e correção de cor;
  • Criar diferentes versões e adaptações de um mesmo conteúdo;
  • Transformar materiais brutos em vídeos finais dinâmicos, profissionais e capazes de manter a atenção da audiência.

Buscamos alguém que saiba editar não apenas vídeos rápidos e cortes para redes sociais, mas que também consiga construir e sustentar uma narrativa audiovisual em conteúdos de maior duração .

Inteligência Artificial no processo criativo

O uso de Inteligência Artificial faz parte da nossa visão de produção criativa .

Esperamos que o profissional tenha familiaridade com ferramentas de IA — e curiosidade para acompanhar rapidamente a evolução desse mercado — aplicadas a atividades como:

  • Criação e geração de imagens;
  • Edição e manipulação de imagens;
  • Desenvolvimento de referências e conceitos visuais;
